children: Bengaluru: LTM (formerly LTIMindtree) reported a mixed performance in the September quarter, with net profit remaining almost flat edging down by 0.1% year-on-year even as revenue rose 13.6% amid cost pressures and lower non-operating income. The Mumbai-based IT services company's net profit for the second quarter of FY27 fell 4.8% sequentially to 1,398 crore while revenue rose 1.7% from the June quarter to 11,807.6 crore. The revenue growth was supported by financial services, consumer and production sectors in key regions of North America and Europe. Rest of the World region and technology and services vertical showed a sequential degrowth.

title: LTM Q2 Net Profit Flat at 1,398 cr, Revenue Increases 13.6% YoY
